ideal: Every change into main is counted daily; few need repair, those are repaired within an hour, and work merges within a day.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Linking a pull request to an issue
Google Cloud: Using the Four Keys to measure your DevOps performance

quality: At most one change in twenty needs repair or is rework, and nine in ten trace to an issue or a board card.
speed: Changes land on most days, merge within a day of their first commit, and a failure is repaired within an hour.
consumption: The daily read uses few API calls and one short job.
